title_new: What do you think of your three options?
thanks_active: Thank you, {first_name}! You sent {n_done} of {n_core} registrations. Your answers are part of the results below, and they make the advice for farms around you more reliable.
thanks_active_missing: If you still have notes from {missing}, we would be glad to receive them.
thanks_partial: Thank you for your answers so far, {first_name}! You sent {n_done} of {n_core} registrations. We are missing {missing} from you. See below what the others said about the same options.
thanks_new: Hello, {first_name}! Your plots are part of a network of {n_farms} farms{group_in}. We have not received your answers yet, but it is not too late. Here is what the others said about exactly your three options.
points_note: The points show the chance that each of your three options is liked best, from the answers of {ref_n} farms{group_in} on {ref_trait}. The three share 100 points.
ranking_note: The ranking is based on {ref_n} of {n_farms} farms{group_in}. With few answers the order is uncertain, especially in the middle. Every new answer makes it more reliable. The results are the farmers' own judgements, not measured yield. The tested options may not be released or available for some time.
cta_text_next: Keep following the same plots A, B and C. The QR code takes you straight to the registration for your package.
cta_title_missing: Send your answers. It takes five minutes.
cta_text_missing: The more farms that answer, the more reliable the advice for your area.
cta_step1: Go to the field and look at plots A, B and C.
cta_step2: For each trait, say which was best and which was worst.
cta_step3: Scan the QR code. It takes you straight to the registration for your package.
items_intro: The options tested{group_in}. Yours are highlighted: {mine}.
cert_for: for taking part in the {trial_name} trial in {year}, testing {n_items} {crop} options on their own farm and sharing their judgement with the network.
flyer_how: 1 Go to the field and look at the three options A, B and C.   2 For each trait, say which was best and which was worst.   3 Go to {website} and use the QR code for your package. You get your own farm report back.
flyer_symbols_note: The symbols show the chance that the option beats an average option (++ above 70 %, + above 58 %, − below 42 %, −− below 30 %). The order follows "liked best overall". n is the number of farms with valid answers. Traits with too few answers are left out.
cert_thanks: Thank you for your time, your land and your knowledge.
flyer_band_title_all: Thank you to everyone who sent their answers.
flyer_band_all: The results get more reliable with every answer. Next season, go to {website} and use the QR code for your package.
flyer_band_title_missing: Did you plant the trial? We are missing your answers.
flyer_band_missing: Sending your answers takes a few minutes. Go to {website} and use the QR code for your package.
